title: What TLA+ can and can't check
title_zh: What TLA+可以和不可以检查

paragraphs.en: Last week Boris Cherny, the inventor of Claude Code, mentioned that Opus was able to use TLA+ 1 to find race conditions in code.
paragraphs.zh: 上周，Claude Code 的发明者 Boris Cherny 提到，Opus 能够使用 TLA+ 1 来发现代码中的竞态条件（race conditions）。

paragraphs.en: And now everybody on the internet is talking about formal verification.
paragraphs.zh: 现在整个互联网上的人都在谈论形式化验证。

paragraphs.en: As a long-time educator ( 1 2 ) and advocate of TLA+, this is really exciting! TLA+ is great at designing complex concurrent systems and making sure they're bug-free. 2 As a long-time advocate of level-headedness, this new euphoria worries me. I read a lot of people saying that formal methods will solve the problem of agentic software development once and for all, and that's nonsense.
paragraphs.zh: 作为一名长期的教育工作者（1 2）和 TLA+ 的倡导者，这真令人兴奋！ TLA+ 擅长设计复杂的并发系统，并确保它们没有缺陷。2 作为一名长期倡导冷静理性的人，这种新的狂热让我感到担忧。 我看到很多人说形式化方法将一劳永逸地解决智能体软件开发的问题，这纯属无稽之谈。

sents.en: As a long-time educator ( 1 2 ) and advocate of TLA+, this is really exciting!
sents.zh: 作为一名长期的教育工作者（1 2）和 TLA+ 的倡导者，这真令人兴奋！

sents.en: TLA+ is great at designing complex concurrent systems and making sure they're bug-free. 2 As a long-time advocate of level-headedness, this new euphoria worries me.
sents.zh: TLA+ 擅长设计复杂的并发系统，并确保它们没有缺陷。2 作为一名长期倡导冷静理性的人，这种新的狂热让我感到担忧。

sents.en: I read a lot of people saying that formal methods will solve the problem of agentic software development once and for all, and that's nonsense.
sents.zh: 我看到很多人说形式化方法将一劳永逸地解决智能体软件开发的问题，这纯属无稽之谈。

paragraphs.en: Enough words have been spilled about the weaknesses of TLA+ in terms of what it can guarantee, like how correct designs don't automatically translate into correct code . So I'd like to focus on a different limitation for this newsletter: to verify a property, we need to have a property to verify! So what are the properties that TLA+ can't even express?
paragraphs.zh: 关于 TLA+ 在所能保证的方面存在的缺陷，已经有过许多讨论，比如正确的设计并不会自动转化为正确的代码。 所以在这期通讯中，我想聚焦于另一个局限：要验证一个性质，我们首先得有一个可供验证的性质！ 那么，哪些性质是 TLA+ 甚至无法表达的呢？

sents.en: Enough words have been spilled about the weaknesses of TLA+ in terms of what it can guarantee, like how correct designs don't automatically translate into correct code .

sents.en: So I'd like to focus on a different limitation for this newsletter: to verify a property, we need to have a property to verify!
sents.zh: 所以在这期通讯中，我想聚焦于另一个局限：要验证一个性质，我们首先得有一个可供验证的性质！

sents.en: So what are the properties that TLA+ can't even express?
sents.zh: 那么，哪些性质是 TLA+ 甚至无法表达的呢？

paragraphs.en: TLA+ divides the system into a set of behaviors. Each behavior is a sequence of states, like "light one is green, then yellow, then red". In each state we can express a regular boolean expressions like "Light four is green" or "All lights are red." We can also modify expressions with three "temporal" logical operators:
paragraphs.zh: TLA+ 将系统划分为一组行为。 每个行为是一个状态序列，比如「1 号灯先是绿色，然后是黄色，再是红色」。 在每个状态中，我们可以表达普通的布尔表达式，比如「4 号灯是绿色」或「所有灯都是红色」。我们还可以用三个「时序」逻辑运算符来修饰表达式：

sents.en: TLA+ divides the system into a set of behaviors.
sents.zh: TLA+ 将系统划分为一组行为。

sents.en: Each behavior is a sequence of states, like "light one is green, then yellow, then red".
sents.zh: 每个行为是一个状态序列，比如「1 号灯先是绿色，然后是黄色，再是红色」。

sents.en: In each state we can express a regular boolean expressions like "Light four is green" or "All lights are red." We can also modify expressions with three "temporal" logical operators:
sents.zh: 在每个状态中，我们可以表达普通的布尔表达式，比如「4 号灯是绿色」或「所有灯都是红色」。我们还可以用三个「时序」逻辑运算符来修饰表达式：

paragraphs.en: When we say that P is a property of the system, we mean it is true in the initial state of every behavior. So if we check the property []P , that means that []P is true in every initial state, and then by the definition of "always" means that P is true in every future state from that initial state, meaning it is true in every state of every behavior. We call this an invariant , and is one of the most foundational properties we check in TLA+.
paragraphs.zh: 当我们说 P 是系统的一个性质时，意思是在每个行为的初始状态下它都为真。 因此，如果我们检查性质 []P，那意味着 []P 在每个初始状态下都为真，而根据「始终」的定义，这意味着 P 在从该初始状态出发的每个未来状态下都为真，也就是说，它在每个行为的每个状态下都为真。 我们称之为不变式，它是我们在 TLA+ 中检查的最基础的性质之一。

sents.en: When we say that P is a property of the system, we mean it is true in the initial state of every behavior.
sents.zh: 当我们说 P 是系统的一个性质时，意思是在每个行为的初始状态下它都为真。

sents.en: So if we check the property []P , that means that []P is true in every initial state, and then by the definition of "always" means that P is true in every future state from that initial state, meaning it is true in every state of every behavior.
sents.zh: 因此，如果我们检查性质 []P，那意味着 []P 在每个初始状态下都为真，而根据「始终」的定义，这意味着 P 在从该初始状态出发的每个未来状态下都为真，也就是说，它在每个行为的每个状态下都为真。

sents.en: We call this an invariant , and is one of the most foundational properties we check in TLA+.
sents.zh: 我们称之为不变式，它是我们在 TLA+ 中检查的最基础的性质之一。

paragraphs.en: We can also compose [] with primes to get action properties , or change variants. [](x' >= x) is true if the new value of x is always greater than equal to the old value of x. Another fun one is [](P => P') : once P is true, it can never become false again. The actual TLA+ is a little more complicated because of a thing called "stutter-invariance", but that's extra details. Action properties and invariants are both safety properties, which roughly means "something bad never happens". I wrote an article on safety and liveness here .
paragraphs.zh: 我们还可以用质子（primes）组合[]来得到动作属性（action properties），或者改变变体。 [](x' >= x) 为真，当且仅当 x 的新值总是大于等于 x 的旧值。 另一个有趣的例子是 [](P => P')：一旦 P 为真，它就再也不会变为假。 由于一种叫作“stutter-invariance”（不变化不变性）的东西，实际的 TLA+ 会稍微复杂一些，但那只是额外的细节。 动作属性和不变式都属于安全性属性，大致意思是“坏事永远不会发生”。 我在这里写了一篇关于安全性和活性的文章。

sents.zh: 我们还可以用质子（primes）组合[]来得到动作属性（action properties），或者改变变体。

sents.en: [](x' >= x) is true if the new value of x is always greater than equal to the old value of x.
sents.zh: [](x' >= x) 为真，当且仅当 x 的新值总是大于等于 x 的旧值。

sents.en: Another fun one is [](P => P') : once P is true, it can never become false again.
sents.zh: 另一个有趣的例子是 [](P => P')：一旦 P 为真，它就再也不会变为假。

sents.en: The actual TLA+ is a little more complicated because of a thing called "stutter-invariance", but that's extra details.
sents.zh: 由于一种叫作“stutter-invariance”（不变化不变性）的东西，实际的 TLA+ 会稍微复杂一些，但那只是额外的细节。

sents.en: Action properties and invariants are both safety properties, which roughly means "something bad never happens".
sents.zh: 动作属性和不变式都属于安全性属性，大致意思是“坏事永远不会发生”。

sents.en: I wrote an article on safety and liveness here .
sents.zh: 我在这里写了一篇关于安全性和活性的文章。

paragraphs.en: Liveness, btw, is "something good always happens". All liveness properties are based off of <> . By itself, <>P just means "P is true in at least one state of every behavior", which is usually too weak to be a good system property. But with composition, we can make more interesting liveness properties:

sents.zh: 所有活性性质都基于 <> 。

sents.zh: 单独来看，<>P 只表示「P 在每个行为的至少一个状态中为真」，这通常太弱，不足以成为一个好的系统性质。

paragraphs.en: There's a couple of other operators, like ENABLED and <<A>>_v , which open up other tricks, but the majority of the stuff we check are invariants, action properties, and liveness. And refinement , which is a combination of safety and liveness and a topic unto itself.
paragraphs.zh: 还有其他一些运算符，比如 ENABLED 和 <<A>>_v，它们能带来其他技巧，但我们检查的大部分内容都是不变量、动作属性和活性。 还有精化（refinement），它是安全性和活性的结合，本身就是一个独立的话题。

sents.zh: 还有精化（refinement），它是安全性和活性的结合，本身就是一个独立的话题。

paragraphs.en: Let's start with the obvious one: if you don't know how to represent your property as a logical formula, then TLA+ can't help you. Nor can any formal method. If you can't formalize the human notion of a bird, you can't prove your app recognizes birds. And, unfortunately, a lot of important properties we care about fall into this category.
paragraphs.zh: 先说一个显而易见的问题：如果你不知道如何把你的属性表示为逻辑公式，那么 TLA+ 也帮不了你。 任何形式化方法也都帮不了。 如果你无法把“鸟”这个人类概念形式化，你就无法证明你的应用能识别鸟。 而且，遗憾的是，我们关心的很多重要属性都属于这一类。

sents.en: Let's start with the obvious one: if you don't know how to represent your property as a logical formula, then TLA+ can't help you.
sents.zh: 先说一个显而易见的问题：如果你不知道如何把你的属性表示为逻辑公式，那么 TLA+ 也帮不了你。

sents.en: Nor can any formal method.
sents.zh: 任何形式化方法也都帮不了。

sents.en: If you can't formalize the human notion of a bird, you can't prove your app recognizes birds.
sents.zh: 如果你无法把“鸟”这个人类概念形式化，你就无法证明你的应用能识别鸟。

sents.en: And, unfortunately, a lot of important properties we care about fall into this category.
sents.zh: 而且，遗憾的是，我们关心的很多重要属性都属于这一类。

paragraphs.en: Next, the overly specific things. TLA+ safety properties work on the level of either individual states (invariants) or single step (action properties). You can't natively define a property over two or more steps, like "pressing delete and then undo gives you back the original state", or "once power is pressed, the computer turns on within ten steps". We also can't define properties on floating point operations or over real time, just logical time .
paragraphs.zh: 接下来讲那些过于具体的东西。 TLA+ 的安全属性（safety properties）只能在单个状态（不变式）或单步（动作属性）的层面起作用。 你无法原生定义跨越两步或更多步的属性，比如「先按删除再按撤销就能恢复原始状态」，或者「一旦按下电源键，计算机就会在十步之内开机」。 我们也无法在浮点运算或真实时间上定义属性，只能针对逻辑时间。

sents.en: Next, the overly specific things.
sents.zh: 接下来讲那些过于具体的东西。

sents.en: TLA+ safety properties work on the level of either individual states (invariants) or single step (action properties).
sents.zh: TLA+ 的安全属性（safety properties）只能在单个状态（不变式）或单步（动作属性）的层面起作用。

sents.en: You can't natively define a property over two or more steps, like "pressing delete and then undo gives you back the original state", or "once power is pressed, the computer turns on within ten steps".
sents.zh: 你无法原生定义跨越两步或更多步的属性，比如「先按删除再按撤销就能恢复原始状态」，或者「一旦按下电源键，计算机就会在十步之内开机」。

sents.en: We also can't define properties on floating point operations or over real time, just logical time .
sents.zh: 我们也无法在浮点运算或真实时间上定义属性，只能针对逻辑时间。

paragraphs.en: Now for limit that most interests me. TLA+ properties are implicitly quantified over all behaviors. I said that checking []P means "P is true in every state," but what it actually means is "for all behaviors, []P is true of that behavior's initial state." Any property TLA+ can check of the system must be a property that is true for every individual behavior.
paragraphs.zh: 现在来看我最感兴趣的那种时序limit（极限）。 TLA+ 属性隐式地对所有行为（behavior）进行了全称量词限定。 我说过，检查 []P 意味着「P 在每个状态都为真」，但它实际的意思是「对于所有行为，[]P 对该行为的初始状态为真」。TLA+ 能对系统检查的任何属性，都必须是对每一个单独的行为都成立的属性。

sents.en: Now for limit that most interests me.
sents.zh: 现在来看我最感兴趣的那种时序limit（极限）。

sents.en: TLA+ properties are implicitly quantified over all behaviors.
sents.zh: TLA+ 属性隐式地对所有行为（behavior）进行了全称量词限定。

sents.en: I said that checking []P means "P is true in every state," but what it actually means is "for all behaviors, []P is true of that behavior's initial state." Any property TLA+ can check of the system must be a property that is true for every individual behavior.
sents.zh: 我说过，检查 []P 意味着「P 在每个状态都为真」，但它实际的意思是「对于所有行为，[]P 对该行为的初始状态为真」。TLA+ 能对系统检查的任何属性，都必须是对每一个单独的行为都成立的属性。

paragraphs.en: What does that leave out? A lot more than you'd expect!
paragraphs.zh: 这遗漏了什么呢？ 比你预期的要多得多！

sents.en: What does that leave out?
sents.zh: 这遗漏了什么呢？

sents.en: A lot more than you'd expect!
sents.zh: 比你预期的要多得多！

paragraphs.en: For one, we can't do "there exists a behavior where P is true". So we can't say that P is possible, even if we don't actually reach it. One example of this would be proving that a game is winnable. We call these reachability properties . More advanced reachability properties would be things like "P is reachable from every initial state" or "P is reachable from any state where Q is true".
paragraphs.zh: 首先，我们无法表达「存在某个行为使得 P 为真」。 因此我们无法说 P 是可能的，即使我们实际上并未到达它。 一个例子就是证明某个游戏是可获胜的。 我们把这类性质称为可达性性质。 更高级的可达性性质包括诸如「P 从每个初始状态都是可达的」或「P 从任何 Q 为真的状态都是可达的」。

sents.en: For one, we can't do "there exists a behavior where P is true".
sents.zh: 首先，我们无法表达「存在某个行为使得 P 为真」。

sents.en: So we can't say that P is possible, even if we don't actually reach it.
sents.zh: 因此我们无法说 P 是可能的，即使我们实际上并未到达它。

sents.en: One example of this would be proving that a game is winnable.
sents.zh: 一个例子就是证明某个游戏是可获胜的。

sents.en: We call these reachability properties .
sents.zh: 我们把这类性质称为可达性性质。

sents.en: More advanced reachability properties would be things like "P is reachable from every initial state" or "P is reachable from any state where Q is true".
sents.zh: 更高级的可达性性质包括诸如「P 从每个初始状态都是可达的」或「P 从任何 Q 为真的状态都是可达的」。

paragraphs.en: We also can't define properties over a set of behaviors. This is called a hyperproperty . Say we we're modeling phone hardware and want to verify that energy saving mode always uses less energy than normal mode. The property is "any sequence of actions uses no more power in energy saving mode than in regular mode." To refute this, you'd need to give me two behaviors that were identical except one starts in energy saving mode and the other does not, and the regular mode uses less power. One single behavior isn't enough to cut it, so this is impossible to naturally check in TLA+.
paragraphs.zh: 我们也无法在一组行为上定义性质。 这被称为超性质（hyperproperty）。 假设我们要为手机硬件建模，并想验证节能模式总是比普通模式消耗更少的电量。 这个性质是“在节能模式下，任何动作序列所消耗的电量都不超过普通模式。”要反驳它，你需要给我两个行为，它们除了一点不同外完全相同：一个以节能模式开始，另一个不是，而且普通模式消耗的电量更少。 单独一个行为是不够的，因此这无法在 TLA+ 中自然地进行检查。

sents.en: We also can't define properties over a set of behaviors.
sents.zh: 我们也无法在一组行为上定义性质。

sents.en: This is called a hyperproperty .
sents.zh: 这被称为超性质（hyperproperty）。

sents.en: Say we we're modeling phone hardware and want to verify that energy saving mode always uses less energy than normal mode.
sents.zh: 假设我们要为手机硬件建模，并想验证节能模式总是比普通模式消耗更少的电量。

sents.en: The property is "any sequence of actions uses no more power in energy saving mode than in regular mode." To refute this, you'd need to give me two behaviors that were identical except one starts in energy saving mode and the other does not, and the regular mode uses less power.
sents.zh: 这个性质是“在节能模式下，任何动作序列所消耗的电量都不超过普通模式。”要反驳它，你需要给我两个行为，它们除了一点不同外完全相同：一个以节能模式开始，另一个不是，而且普通模式消耗的电量更少。

sents.en: One single behavior isn't enough to cut it, so this is impossible to naturally check in TLA+.
sents.zh: 单独一个行为是不够的，因此这无法在 TLA+ 中自然地进行检查。

paragraphs.en: Hyperproperties might seem niche but they cover a ton of security properties and all statistical properties ("the 95%ile response time is 5ms").
paragraphs.zh: 超属性（Hyperproperties）看起来可能比较小众，但它们涵盖了大量的安全属性以及所有统计属性（例如“95% 分位的响应时间为 5ms”）。

paragraphs.en: Finally, and this one's a little more academic, we can't define properties over the state space as a whole. We can't say, for example, that there's only one path from state X to Y. I don't know how useful this would be in practice. Most of these kinds of "metaproperties" seem like they have potential to be meaningful, I just don't know what specifically.
paragraphs.zh: 最后，这一条稍微偏学术一些，我们不能在整个状态空间上整体定义属性。 例如，我们不能说从状态 X 到 Y 只有一条路径。 我不知道这在实际中会有多大用处。 这类「元属性」中的大多数看起来都有可能是有意义的，只是我不清楚具体是什么意义。

sents.en: Finally, and this one's a little more academic, we can't define properties over the state space as a whole.
sents.zh: 最后，这一条稍微偏学术一些，我们不能在整个状态空间上整体定义属性。

sents.en: We can't say, for example, that there's only one path from state X to Y.
sents.zh: 例如，我们不能说从状态 X 到 Y 只有一条路径。

sents.en: I don't know how useful this would be in practice.
sents.zh: 我不知道这在实际中会有多大用处。

sents.en: Most of these kinds of "metaproperties" seem like they have potential to be meaningful, I just don't know what specifically.
sents.zh: 这类「元属性」中的大多数看起来都有可能是有意义的，只是我不清楚具体是什么意义。

paragraphs.en: I kind of oversimplified when I said that TLA+ can't do these things. I mean that if you are writing a spec, and that spec directly corresponds to the system you want to build, then TLA+ can't express these as properties of your system. But you can mimic two-step properties with auxiliary variables , like storing all state changes in a state_history sequence and defining the property as an invariant on that sequence. You can mimic some hyperproperties with self-composition , where each behavior of the self-composed spec is two behaviors of the actual system. The main TLA+ model checker (TLC) can check the most basic reachability properties with the new REACHABLE keyword and some state-space properties with TLCGet . Andrew Helwer has a crazy post about mimicking "always reachable" with fairness and "machine closure."
paragraphs.zh: 我之前说 TLA+ 做不了这些事情，其实有点过于简化了。 我的意思是，如果你在写一个规约，而这个规约直接对应于你想要构建的系统，那么 TLA+ 就无法把这些表示为该系统的属性。 但你可以用辅助变量来模拟两步属性，比如把所有状态变更存储在一个 state_history 序列中，并将该属性定义为这个序列上的一个不变式。 你可以用自组合来模拟某些超属性，其中自组合规约的每条行为对应于实际系统的两条行为。 TLA+ 的主要模型检测器（TLC）可以通过新增的 REACHABLE 关键字检查最基本的可达性属性，并借助 TLCGet 检查一些状态空间属性。 Andrew Helwer 写过一篇非常疯狂的文章，讲的是如何用公平性和「机器封闭」来模拟「始终可达」。

sents.en: I kind of oversimplified when I said that TLA+ can't do these things.
sents.zh: 我之前说 TLA+ 做不了这些事情，其实有点过于简化了。

sents.en: I mean that if you are writing a spec, and that spec directly corresponds to the system you want to build, then TLA+ can't express these as properties of your system.
sents.zh: 我的意思是，如果你在写一个规约，而这个规约直接对应于你想要构建的系统，那么 TLA+ 就无法把这些表示为该系统的属性。

sents.en: But you can mimic two-step properties with auxiliary variables , like storing all state changes in a state_history sequence and defining the property as an invariant on that sequence.
sents.zh: 但你可以用辅助变量来模拟两步属性，比如把所有状态变更存储在一个 state_history 序列中，并将该属性定义为这个序列上的一个不变式。

sents.en: You can mimic some hyperproperties with self-composition , where each behavior of the self-composed spec is two behaviors of the actual system.
sents.zh: 你可以用自组合来模拟某些超属性，其中自组合规约的每条行为对应于实际系统的两条行为。

sents.en: The main TLA+ model checker (TLC) can check the most basic reachability properties with the new REACHABLE keyword and some state-space properties with TLCGet .
sents.zh: TLA+ 的主要模型检测器（TLC）可以通过新增的 REACHABLE 关键字检查最基本的可达性属性，并借助 TLCGet 检查一些状态空间属性。

sents.en: Andrew Helwer has a crazy post about mimicking "always reachable" with fairness and "machine closure."
sents.zh: Andrew Helwer 写过一篇非常疯狂的文章，讲的是如何用公平性和「机器封闭」来模拟「始终可达」。

paragraphs.en: These are useful hacks, but they're still hacks. Each one takes a lot of cleverness to figure out and comes with serious drawbacks. Auxiliary variables ruin refinements, self-composition exponentiates your state space, etc. Hacks don't compose well with the other TLA+ features and don't cover all the intricacies of properties you'd want to express. And worst of all, they make your models look weird and messy and not correspond to your actual systems.
paragraphs.zh: 这些是有用的技巧，但它们仍然是技巧。 每一种都需要费不少心思才能想出来，而且都带有严重的缺点。 辅助变量会破坏精化，自组合会让你的状态空间指数级膨胀，等等。 这些技巧与其他 TLA+ 特性配合不佳，也无法涵盖你想表达的所有属性的复杂性。 最糟糕的是，它们会让你的模型看起来又怪又乱，与你的实际系统不相对应。

sents.en: These are useful hacks, but they're still hacks.
sents.zh: 这些是有用的技巧，但它们仍然是技巧。

sents.en: Each one takes a lot of cleverness to figure out and comes with serious drawbacks.
sents.zh: 每一种都需要费不少心思才能想出来，而且都带有严重的缺点。

sents.en: Auxiliary variables ruin refinements, self-composition exponentiates your state space, etc.
sents.zh: 辅助变量会破坏精化，自组合会让你的状态空间指数级膨胀，等等。

sents.en: Hacks don't compose well with the other TLA+ features and don't cover all the intricacies of properties you'd want to express.
sents.zh: 这些技巧与其他 TLA+ 特性配合不佳，也无法涵盖你想表达的所有属性的复杂性。

sents.en: And worst of all, they make your models look weird and messy and not correspond to your actual systems.
sents.zh: 最糟糕的是，它们会让你的模型看起来又怪又乱，与你的实际系统不相对应。

paragraphs.en: You could also use a different tool with a different focus. CTL can do reachability properties, PRISM probabilistic properties, etc. They trade off by being worse at things that TLA+ can do, and of course none of them handle properties we can't express logically.
paragraphs.zh: 你也可以使用另一个侧重点不同的工具。 CTL 可以验证可达性属性，PRISM 可以验证概率属性，等等。 它们的代价是在 TLA+ 能做到的方面表现较差，当然，它们都无法处理我们在逻辑上无法表达的属性。

sents.en: You could also use a different tool with a different focus.
sents.zh: 你也可以使用另一个侧重点不同的工具。

sents.en: CTL can do reachability properties, PRISM probabilistic properties, etc.
sents.zh: CTL 可以验证可达性属性，PRISM 可以验证概率属性，等等。

sents.en: They trade off by being worse at things that TLA+ can do, and of course none of them handle properties we can't express logically.
sents.zh: 它们的代价是在 TLA+ 能做到的方面表现较差，当然，它们都无法处理我们在逻辑上无法表达的属性。

paragraphs.en: Ultimately TLA+ is pretty good at picking a lot of low hanging fruit- invariants and liveness cover many things we care about, and TLA+ is reasonably good at expressing and checking them. There's a lot of potential (and a a lot of pitfalls ) in using TLA+ to check vibe code. But there are also many things it cannot even express, let alone check.
paragraphs.zh: 最终来看，TLA+ 非常擅长摘取大量低垂的果实——不变式和活性涵盖了我们关心的许多方面，而且 TLA+ 在表达和检验它们方面也相当出色。 用 TLA+ 来检查凭感觉生成的代码，既有很大的潜力，也有很多的陷阱。 但也有很多东西它甚至无法表达，更不用说检验了。

sents.zh: 但也有很多东西它甚至无法表达，更不用说检验了。
